<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}*:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
body{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);line-height:1.75}
a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--gold-soft)}
.main-banner{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000}
.banner-row{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 16px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.banner-lrr{justify-self:start}.banner-logo{justify-self:center}
.banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:108px;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.banner-contact{justify-self:end;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;text-align:center}
.banner-phone{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px}
.banner-email{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;display:block}
.banner-tabs{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 12px 10px;display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.banner-tabs>a{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8);padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}
.banner-tabs>a:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);color:var(--gold)}
.banner-tabs>a.mil-link{color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin-left:6px}
header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));padding:60px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);text-align:center}
header>*{max-width:900px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,46px);color:#fff;line-height:1.15;margin:0 auto 14px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.lead,header p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;max-width:720px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 24px}
main p{color:var(--text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;margin:1rem auto;font-weight:400;max-width:760px}
main p strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
main h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,38px);line-height:1.18;color:#fff;margin:48px auto 16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold-line);letter-spacing:-0.01em;max-width:760px}
main h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,20px);color:var(--gold);margin:34px auto 12px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;max-width:760px}
main ul,main ol{color:var(--text);padding-left:1.25rem;margin:.75rem auto;font-weight:400;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.7;max-width:760px}
main li{margin:.4rem 0}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.08),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.75rem;margin:2.5rem auto;text-align:center;max-width:760px}
.cta strong{color:#fff}
.cta a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
details{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:8px;margin:.5rem auto;padding:1rem 1.25rem;max-width:760px}
details[open]{border-color:var(--gold-line)}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17px}
details p{color:var(--text);margin-top:.75rem;font-size:16px}
footer{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 24px 3rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
footer p{margin:.5rem 0;color:var(--muted)}
footer a{color:var(--gold)}
.btn-p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn-p:hover{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-g{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:760px}
/* index hero */
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);padding:64px 24px}
.hero-grid{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.hero-eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}
.hero h1{text-align:left;margin:0 0 18px}
.hero .lead{text-align:left;margin:0 0 26px;max-width:560px}
.hero-portrait{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow:hidden;line-height:0}
.hero-portrait img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top}
.trust-band{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.12),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold-line);padding:30px 24px}
.tb-grid{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
.tb-tile{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 14px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .15s,border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
a.tb-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(201,168,76,0.18)}
.tb-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:21px;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(201,168,76,0.45)}
.tb-big{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.tb-mid{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.tb-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.4px;line-height:1.4}
.tb-kicker{color:var(--gold);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase}
@media(max-width:700px){.tb-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.tb-big{font-size:26px}}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin:2rem auto;max-width:900px}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.card h3{margin:0!important;font-size:22px!important;text-transform:none!important;letter-spacing:0!important;color:#fff!important}
.card p{font-size:15px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0!important;flex:1}
.card a.card-link{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:900px}
.review-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.review-card .stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:10px}
.review-card p{color:#D1D5DB!important;font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.7!important;font-style:italic;margin:0 0 14px!important;flex:1}
.review-card .who{color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.review-card .meta{color:var(--mutedD);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:1rem auto 2rem;max-width:760px}
.chips a{background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;border:1px solid var(--hair)}
.chips a:hover{border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold)}
.mil-band{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin:3rem auto;max-width:760px;text-align:center}
.mil-band h3{margin:0 0 10px!important}
.mil-band p{margin:0 0 16px!important}
.inq-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:26px 28px;margin:40px auto;max-width:760px}
.inq-cta .iq{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold-line);padding-left:14px}
.inq-cta .ih{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px;font-weight:500}
.inq-cta .is{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 18px}
.inq-cta .ir{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.inq-cta .ip{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.inq-cta .il{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans)}
/* sticky mobile CTA */
.sticky-mobile-cta{display:none}
@media (max-width:800px){
  .sticky-mobile-cta{display:flex;gap:10px;position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:9999}
  .sticky-mobile-cta a{flex:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.2px;font-family:var(--sans);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-call{background:#C9A84C;color:#0A0F1A}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-text{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-email{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  iframe[name="widgetCta"]{display:none!important}
}
/* inquiry modal */
.imodal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,15,26,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:2000;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:80px 20px 40px;overflow-y:auto}
.imodal-overlay.open{display:flex}
.imodal{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:40px 32px 32px;width:100%;max-width:560px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);text-align:left}
.imodal-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:14px;background:transparent;border:none;color:#999;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:6px}
.imodal h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;color:#fff;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center;font-weight:500;border:none;padding:0}
.imodal .isub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center}
.imodal form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}
.imodal label{color:#999;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.imodal input,.imodal select,.imodal textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--elev);border:1px solid #444;border-radius:8px;color:#fff;font-size:14px;outline:none;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ihp{position:absolute;left:-9999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.imodal .isubmit{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-top:8px;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ifine{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px;text-align:center}
.imodal .iok{background:#1a3a1a;border:2px solid #3aa03a;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.imodal .ierr{background:#3a1a1a;border:1px solid #a03a3a;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#ff9999;font-size:13px}
.hero-cta-overlay{display:none}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
  .hero-portrait{max-width:380px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
  .hero-portrait::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,15,26,0) 0%,rgba(10,15,26,0.85) 100%);border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;pointer-events:none}
  .hero .btn-row{display:none}
  .hero-cta-overlay{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:16px;z-index:2}
  .hero-cta-overlay .btn-p,.hero-cta-overlay .btn-g{width:100%;max-width:320px;justify-content:center}
  .hero-cta-overlay .btn-g{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.55);color:#fff;border-color:var(--gold)}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  main{padding:32px 16px}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:56px!important}
  .banner-row{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  main h2{font-size:25px!important;margin:38px auto 14px;padding-bottom:10px}
  main h3{font-size:17px!important}
  main h2,main h3{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  main p{font-size:16.5px}
  main ul,main ol{font-size:16px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  main{padding:24px 14px 14px!important}
  header{padding:32px 14px 22px!important}
  .hero{padding:36px 14px!important}
  h1{font-size:clamp(22px,7vw,30px)!important}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:44px!important}
  .banner-phone{font-size:13px!important}
  .banner-email{font-size:9px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a{padding:4px 6px!important;font-size:9px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important}
}

/*FIGURE_CSS*/
.figure-band{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);line-height:0;margin:2.25rem auto .5rem;border:1px solid var(--hair);max-width:760px}
.figure-band picture{display:block}
.figure-band img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover}
.figure-band--tall img{aspect-ratio:auto;max-height:600px;object-fit:contain;background:var(--panel)}
.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
figure{margin:0}
figcaption{line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-style:italic;text-align:center;margin:8px 0 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.2px;padding:0 10px 10px}
figcaption a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline}
@media(max-width:640px){.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:auto}}
.imodal .ifine a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline}

/* MOBILE_DRAWER_START */
/* The drawer markup stays in the page but is never shown; the toggle must be hidden at EVERY width. */
.nav-toggle{display:none!important}
.main-banner{position:sticky;top:0}
/* Phones: keep every top-level tab visible (owner preference). */
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .nav-toggle{display:none!important}
  .site-drawer{display:block!important;position:static!important;top:auto!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;background:none!important;padding:0!important;overflow:visible!important;z-index:auto!important}
  .main-banner{position:sticky!important;top:0!important;z-index:1000}
  /* even spacing around the logos and the phone rather than one item pinned to each edge */
  .banner-row{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;justify-content:space-evenly!important;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px 0!important;gap:8px!important;min-height:0!important}
  .banner-row>*{flex:0 0 auto}
  .banner-lrr{display:block!important;justify-self:start}
  .banner-logo{justify-self:center}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:38px!important}
  .banner-tabs{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:2px!important;padding:4px 6px 8px!important}
  .main-banner .banner-tabs>a,.main-banner .banner-tabs .dropdown>button,.main-banner .banner-tabs .banner-search{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:auto!important;min-height:30px;margin:0!important;padding:5px 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important;line-height:1.1;text-align:center!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;border-bottom:none!important;border-radius:6px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a.mil-link{border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin:0!important}
  .banner-tabs .dropdown{padding:0;position:relative}
  body.drawer-open{overflow:auto!important}
}
@media (max-width: 360px){
  /* the sticky bottom bar already carries Email; the header copy overflows below 360px */
  .main-banner .banner-email{display:none!important}
}
@media (max-width: 480px){
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:32px!important}
  .banner-tabs{gap:1px!important;padding:3px 4px 7px!important}
  .main-banner .banner-tabs>a,.main-banner .banner-tabs .dropdown>button,.main-banner .banner-tabs .banner-search{padding:5px 6px!important;font-size:10.5px!important;letter-spacing:.2px!important}
}
/* MOBILE_DRAWER_END */
.quick-answer{max-width:760px;margin:6px auto 22px;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line,rgba(201,168,76,.35));border-left:4px solid var(--gold,#c9a84c);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel,rgba(255,255,255,.03))}.quick-answer .qa-label{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold,#c9a84c);font-weight:600}.quick-answer .qa-text{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--text,#e8e6df)}.quick-answer .qa-by{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#9aa0aa);font-style:italic}</style>

<style>/* GEO_CORE_CSS */
.geo-guide{max-width:760px;margin:24px auto;border:1px solid var(--gold-line,rgba(201,168,76,.3));border-radius:10px;padding:20px;background:var(--panel,#172331)}
.geo-guide h2,.geo-guide h3{margin-top:0}.geo-guide p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.geo-review{font-size:13px!important;color:var(--muted,#acb7c5)}
.geo-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;margin:12px 0}.geo-links a{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.geo-table-wrap{max-width:900px;margin:18px auto;overflow:auto}.geo-table-wrap table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0}.geo-table-wrap caption{text-align:left;font-size:13px;padding:8px}.geo-table-wrap th,.geo-table-wrap td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair,rgba(255,255,255,.15));text-align:left}.geo-table-wrap:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#c9a84c)}
.geo-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.geo-fields label{display:block;font-size:14px}.geo-fields input,.geo-fields select{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;background:var(--ink,#0b1420);color:var(--text,#eee);border:1px solid var(--hair,#64748b);border-radius:5px;padding:10px;margin-top:5px;font:inherit}.geo-fields input:focus-visible,.geo-fields select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#c9a84c)}
.geo-results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:20px 0}.geo-results div{padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--hair,#64748b);border-radius:6px}.geo-results span{display:block;font-size:13px}.geo-results output{display:block;color:var(--gold,#c9a84c);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.geo-error{color:#ffb6ae;font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:600px){.geo-guide{padding:15px}.geo-fields,.geo-results{grid-template-columns:1fr}.geo-table-wrap th,.geo-table-wrap td{padding:8px;font-size:13px}}
@media(max-width:480px){.main-banner .banner-row{gap:4px!important;padding:6px 4px 0!important}.main-banner .banner-lrr img,.main-banner .banner-logo img{height:40px!important}.main-banner .banner-phone{font-size:13px!important;letter-spacing:0!important}.main-banner .banner-email{font-size:9px!important;letter-spacing:0!important}}</style>

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}*:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
body{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);line-height:1.75}
a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--gold-soft)}
.main-banner{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000}
.banner-row{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 16px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.banner-lrr{justify-self:start}.banner-logo{justify-self:center}
.banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:108px;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.banner-contact{justify-self:end;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;text-align:center}
.banner-phone{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px}
.banner-email{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;display:block}
.banner-tabs{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 12px 10px;display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.banner-tabs>a{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8);padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}
.banner-tabs>a:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);color:var(--gold)}
.banner-tabs>a.mil-link{color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin-left:6px}
header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));padding:60px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);text-align:center}
header>*{max-width:900px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,46px);color:#fff;line-height:1.15;margin:0 auto 14px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.lead,header p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;max-width:720px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 24px}
main p{color:var(--text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;margin:1rem auto;font-weight:400;max-width:760px}
main p strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
main h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,38px);line-height:1.18;color:#fff;margin:48px auto 16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold-line);letter-spacing:-0.01em;max-width:760px}
main h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,20px);color:var(--gold);margin:34px auto 12px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;max-width:760px}
main ul,main ol{color:var(--text);padding-left:1.25rem;margin:.75rem auto;font-weight:400;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.7;max-width:760px}
main li{margin:.4rem 0}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.08),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.75rem;margin:2.5rem auto;text-align:center;max-width:760px}
.cta strong{color:#fff}
.cta a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
details{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:8px;margin:.5rem auto;padding:1rem 1.25rem;max-width:760px}
details[open]{border-color:var(--gold-line)}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17px}
details p{color:var(--text);margin-top:.75rem;font-size:16px}
footer{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 24px 3rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
footer p{margin:.5rem 0;color:var(--muted)}
footer a{color:var(--gold)}
.btn-p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn-p:hover{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-g{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:760px}
/* index hero */
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);padding:64px 24px}
.hero-grid{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.hero-eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}
.hero h1{text-align:left;margin:0 0 18px}
.hero .lead{text-align:left;margin:0 0 26px;max-width:560px}
.hero-portrait{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow:hidden;line-height:0}
.hero-portrait img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top}
.trust-band{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.12),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold-line);padding:30px 24px}
.tb-grid{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
.tb-tile{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 14px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .15s,border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
a.tb-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(201,168,76,0.18)}
.tb-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:21px;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(201,168,76,0.45)}
.tb-big{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.tb-mid{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.tb-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.4px;line-height:1.4}
.tb-kicker{color:var(--gold);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase}
@media(max-width:700px){.tb-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.tb-big{font-size:26px}}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin:2rem auto;max-width:900px}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.card h3{margin:0!important;font-size:22px!important;text-transform:none!important;letter-spacing:0!important;color:#fff!important}
.card p{font-size:15px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0!important;flex:1}
.card a.card-link{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:900px}
.review-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.review-card .stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:10px}
.review-card p{color:#D1D5DB!important;font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.7!important;font-style:italic;margin:0 0 14px!important;flex:1}
.review-card .who{color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.review-card .meta{color:var(--mutedD);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:1rem auto 2rem;max-width:760px}
.chips a{background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;border:1px solid var(--hair)}
.chips a:hover{border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold)}
.mil-band{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin:3rem auto;max-width:760px;text-align:center}
.mil-band h3{margin:0 0 10px!important}
.mil-band p{margin:0 0 16px!important}
.inq-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:26px 28px;margin:40px auto;max-width:760px}
.inq-cta .iq{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold-line);padding-left:14px}
.inq-cta .ih{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px;font-weight:500}
.inq-cta .is{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 18px}
.inq-cta .ir{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.inq-cta .ip{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.inq-cta .il{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans)}
/* sticky mobile CTA */
.sticky-mobile-cta{display:none}
@media (max-width:800px){
  .sticky-mobile-cta{display:flex;gap:10px;position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:9999}
  .sticky-mobile-cta a{flex:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.2px;font-family:var(--sans);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-call{background:#C9A84C;color:#0A0F1A}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-text{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-email{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  iframe[name="widgetCta"]{display:none!important}
}
/* inquiry modal */
.imodal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,15,26,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:2000;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:80px 20px 40px;overflow-y:auto}
.imodal-overlay.open{display:flex}
.imodal{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:40px 32px 32px;width:100%;max-width:560px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);text-align:left}
.imodal-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:14px;background:transparent;border:none;color:#999;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:6px}
.imodal h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;color:#fff;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center;font-weight:500;border:none;padding:0}
.imodal .isub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center}
.imodal form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}
.imodal label{color:#999;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.imodal input,.imodal select,.imodal textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--elev);border:1px solid #444;border-radius:8px;color:#fff;font-size:14px;outline:none;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ihp{position:absolute;left:-9999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.imodal .isubmit{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-top:8px;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ifine{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px;text-align:center}
.imodal .iok{background:#1a3a1a;border:2px solid #3aa03a;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.imodal .ierr{background:#3a1a1a;border:1px solid #a03a3a;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#ff9999;font-size:13px}
.hero-cta-overlay{display:none}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
  .hero-portrait{max-width:380px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
  .hero-portrait::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,15,26,0) 0%,rgba(10,15,26,0.85) 100%);border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;pointer-events:none}
  .hero .btn-row{display:none}
  .hero-cta-overlay{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:16px;z-index:2}
  .hero-cta-overlay .btn-p,.hero-cta-overlay .btn-g{width:100%;max-width:320px;justify-content:center}
  .hero-cta-overlay .btn-g{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.55);color:#fff;border-color:var(--gold)}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  main{padding:32px 16px}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:56px!important}
  .banner-row{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  main h2{font-size:25px!important;margin:38px auto 14px;padding-bottom:10px}
  main h3{font-size:17px!important}
  main h2,main h3{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  main p{font-size:16.5px}
  main ul,main ol{font-size:16px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  main{padding:24px 14px 14px!important}
  header{padding:32px 14px 22px!important}
  .hero{padding:36px 14px!important}
  h1{font-size:clamp(22px,7vw,30px)!important}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:44px!important}
  .banner-phone{font-size:13px!important}
  .banner-email{font-size:9px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a{padding:4px 6px!important;font-size:9px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important}
}

/*FIGURE_CSS*/
.figure-band{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);line-height:0;margin:2.25rem auto .5rem;border:1px solid var(--hair);max-width:760px}
.figure-band picture{display:block}
.figure-band img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover}
.figure-band--tall img{aspect-ratio:auto;max-height:600px;object-fit:contain;background:var(--panel)}
.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
figure{margin:0}
figcaption{line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-style:italic;text-align:center;margin:8px 0 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.2px;padding:0 10px 10px}
figcaption a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline}
@media(max-width:640px){.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:auto}}
.imodal .ifine a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline}

/* MOBILE_DRAWER_START */
/* The drawer markup stays in the page but is never shown; the toggle must be hidden at EVERY width. */
.nav-toggle{display:none!important}
.main-banner{position:sticky;top:0}
/* Phones: keep every top-level tab visible (owner preference). */
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .nav-toggle{display:none!important}
  .site-drawer{display:block!important;position:static!important;top:auto!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;background:none!important;padding:0!important;overflow:visible!important;z-index:auto!important}
  .main-banner{position:sticky!important;top:0!important;z-index:1000}
  /* even spacing around the logos and the phone rather than one item pinned to each edge */
  .banner-row{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;justify-content:space-evenly!important;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px 0!important;gap:8px!important;min-height:0!important}
  .banner-row>*{flex:0 0 auto}
  .banner-lrr{display:block!important;justify-self:start}
  .banner-logo{justify-self:center}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:38px!important}
  .banner-tabs{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:2px!important;padding:4px 6px 8px!important}
  .main-banner .banner-tabs>a,.main-banner .banner-tabs .dropdown>button,.main-banner .banner-tabs .banner-search{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:auto!important;min-height:30px;margin:0!important;padding:5px 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important;line-height:1.1;text-align:center!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;border-bottom:none!important;border-radius:6px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a.mil-link{border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin:0!important}
  .banner-tabs .dropdown{padding:0;position:relative}
  body.drawer-open{overflow:auto!important}
}

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}

@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:300 800;font-display:optional;src:url('/fonts/inter-latin-variable.woff2') format('woff2');unicode-range:U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+02BB-02BC,U+02C6,U+02DA,U+02DC,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+2000-206F,U+2074,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2191,U+2193,U+2212,U+2215,U+FEFF,U+FFFD;}
@font-face{font-family:'Playfair Display';font-style:normal;font-weight:400 700;font-display:optional;src:url('/fonts/playfair-latin-variable.woff2') format('woff2');unicode-range:U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+02BB-02BC,U+02C6,U+02DA,U+02DC,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+2000-206F,U+2074,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2191,U+2193,U+2212,U+2215,U+FEFF,U+FFFD;}

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}*:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
body{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);line-height:1.75}
a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--gold-soft)}
.main-banner{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000}
.banner-row{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 16px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.banner-lrr{justify-self:start}.banner-logo{justify-self:center}
.banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:108px;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.banner-contact{justify-self:end;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;text-align:center}
.banner-phone{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px}
.banner-email{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;display:block}
.banner-tabs{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 12px 10px;display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.banner-tabs>a{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8);padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}
.banner-tabs>a:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);color:var(--gold)}
.banner-tabs>a.mil-link{color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin-left:6px}
header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));padding:60px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);text-align:center}
header>*{max-width:900px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,46px);color:#fff;line-height:1.15;margin:0 auto 14px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.lead,header p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;max-width:720px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 24px}
main p{color:var(--text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;margin:1rem auto;font-weight:400;max-width:760px}
main p strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
main h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,38px);line-height:1.18;color:#fff;margin:48px auto 16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold-line);letter-spacing:-0.01em;max-width:760px}
main h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,20px);color:var(--gold);margin:34px auto 12px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;max-width:760px}
main ul,main ol{color:var(--text);padding-left:1.25rem;margin:.75rem auto;font-weight:400;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.7;max-width:760px}
main li{margin:.4rem 0}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.08),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.75rem;margin:2.5rem auto;text-align:center;max-width:760px}
.cta strong{color:#fff}
.cta a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
details{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:8px;margin:.5rem auto;padding:1rem 1.25rem;max-width:760px}
details[open]{border-color:var(--gold-line)}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17px}
details p{color:var(--text);margin-top:.75rem;font-size:16px}
footer{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 24px 3rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
footer p{margin:.5rem 0;color:var(--muted)}
footer a{color:var(--gold)}
.btn-p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn-p:hover{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-g{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:760px}
/* index hero */
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);padding:64px 24px}
.hero-grid{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.hero-eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}
.hero h1{text-align:left;margin:0 0 18px}
.hero .lead{text-align:left;margin:0 0 26px;max-width:560px}
.hero-portrait{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow:hidden;line-height:0}
.hero-portrait img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top}
.trust-band{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.12),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold-line);padding:30px 24px}
.tb-grid{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
.tb-tile{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 14px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .15s,border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
a.tb-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(201,168,76,0.18)}
.tb-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:21px;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(201,168,76,0.45)}
.tb-big{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.tb-mid{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.tb-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.4px;line-height:1.4}
.tb-kicker{color:var(--gold);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.8px;text-transform:uppercase}
@media(max-width:700px){.tb-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.tb-big{font-size:26px}}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin:2rem auto;max-width:900px}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.card h3{margin:0!important;font-size:22px!important;text-transform:none!important;letter-spacing:0!important;color:#fff!important}
.card p{font-size:15px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0!important;flex:1}
.card a.card-link{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:900px}
.review-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.review-card .stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:10px}
.review-card p{color:#D1D5DB!important;font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.7!important;font-style:italic;margin:0 0 14px!important;flex:1}
.review-card .who{color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.review-card .meta{color:var(--mutedD);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:1rem auto 2rem;max-width:760px}
.chips a{background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;border:1px solid var(--hair)}
.chips a:hover{border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold)}
.mil-band{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin:3rem auto;max-width:760px;text-align:center}
.mil-band h3{margin:0 0 10px!important}
.mil-band p{margin:0 0 16px!important}
.inq-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:26px 28px;margin:40px auto;max-width:760px}
.inq-cta .iq{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold-line);padding-left:14px}
.inq-cta .ih{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px;font-weight:500}
.inq-cta .is{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 18px}
.inq-cta .ir{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.inq-cta .ip{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.inq-cta .il{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans)}
/* sticky mobile CTA */
.sticky-mobile-cta{display:none}
@media (max-width:800px){
  .sticky-mobile-cta{display:flex;gap:10px;position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:9999}
  .sticky-mobile-cta a{flex:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.2px;font-family:var(--sans);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-call{background:#C9A84C;color:#0A0F1A}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-text{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-email{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  iframe[name="widgetCta"]{display:none!important}
}
/* inquiry modal */
.imodal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,15,26,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:2000;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:80px 20px 40px;overflow-y:auto}
.imodal-overlay.open{display:flex}
.imodal{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:40px 32px 32px;width:100%;max-width:560px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);text-align:left}
.imodal-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:14px;background:transparent;border:none;color:#999;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:6px}
.imodal h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;color:#fff;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center;font-weight:500;border:none;padding:0}
.imodal .isub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center}
.imodal form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}
.imodal label{color:#999;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.imodal input,.imodal select,.imodal textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--elev);border:1px solid #444;border-radius:8px;color:#fff;font-size:14px;outline:none;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ihp{position:absolute;left:-9999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.imodal .isubmit{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-top:8px;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ifine{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px;text-align:center}
.imodal .iok{background:#1a3a1a;border:2px solid #3aa03a;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.imodal .ierr{background:#3a1a1a;border:1px solid #a03a3a;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#ff9999;font-size:13px}
.hero-cta-overlay{display:none}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
  .hero-portrait{max-width:380px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
  .hero-portrait::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,15,26,0) 0%,rgba(10,15,26,0.85) 100%);border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;pointer-events:none}
  .hero .btn-row{display:none}
  .hero-cta-overlay{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:16px;z-index:2}
  .hero-cta-overlay .btn-p,.hero-cta-overlay .btn-g{width:100%;max-width:320px;justify-content:center}
  .hero-cta-overlay .btn-g{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.55);color:#fff;border-color:var(--gold)}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  main{padding:32px 16px}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:56px!important}
  .banner-row{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  main h2{font-size:25px!important;margin:38px auto 14px;padding-bottom:10px}
  main h3{font-size:17px!important}
  main h2,main h3{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  main p{font-size:16.5px}
  main ul,main ol{font-size:16px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  main{padding:24px 14px 14px!important}
  header{padding:32px 14px 22px!important}
  .hero{padding:36px 14px!important}
  h1{font-size:clamp(22px,7vw,30px)!important}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:44px!important}
  .banner-phone{font-size:13px!important}
  .banner-email{font-size:9px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a{padding:4px 6px!important;font-size:9px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important}
}

/*FIGURE_CSS*/
.figure-band{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);line-height:0;margin:2.25rem auto .5rem;border:1px solid var(--hair);max-width:760px}
.figure-band picture{display:block}
.figure-band img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover}
.figure-band--tall img{aspect-ratio:auto;max-height:600px;object-fit:contain;background:var(--panel)}
.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
figure{margin:0}
figcaption{line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-style:italic;text-align:center;margin:8px 0 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.2px;padding:0 10px 10px}
figcaption a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline}
@media(max-width:640px){.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:auto}}
.imodal .ifine a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline}

/* MOBILE_DRAWER_START */
/* The drawer markup stays in the page but is never shown; the toggle must be hidden at EVERY width. */
.nav-toggle{display:none!important}
.main-banner{position:sticky;top:0}
/* Phones: keep every top-level tab visible (owner preference). */
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .nav-toggle{display:none!important}
  .site-drawer{display:block!important;position:static!important;top:auto!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;background:none!important;padding:0!important;overflow:visible!important;z-index:auto!important}
  .main-banner{position:sticky!important;top:0!important;z-index:1000}
  /* even spacing around the logos and the phone rather than one item pinned to each edge */
  .banner-row{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;justify-content:space-evenly!important;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px 0!important;gap:8px!important;min-height:0!important}
  .banner-row>*{flex:0 0 auto}
  .banner-lrr{display:block!important;justify-self:start}
  .banner-logo{justify-self:center}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:38px!important}
  .banner-tabs{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:2px!important;padding:4px 6px 8px!important}
  .main-banner .banner-tabs>a,.main-banner .banner-tabs .dropdown>button,.main-banner .banner-tabs .banner-search{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:auto!important;min-height:30px;margin:0!important;padding:5px 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important;line-height:1.1;text-align:center!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;border-bottom:none!important;border-radius:6px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a.mil-link{border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin:0!important}
  .banner-tabs .dropdown{padding:0;position:relative}
  body.drawer-open{overflow:auto!important}
}
@media (max-width: 360px){
  /* the sticky bottom bar already carries Email; the header copy overflows below 360px */
  .main-banner .banner-email{display:none!important}
}
@media (max-width: 480px){
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:32px!important}
  .banner-tabs{gap:1px!important;padding:3px 4px 7px!important}
  .main-banner .banner-tabs>a,.main-banner .banner-tabs .dropdown>button,.main-banner .banner-tabs .banner-search{padding:5px 6px!important;font-size:10.5px!important;letter-spacing:.2px!important}
}
/* MOBILE_DRAWER_END */
</style>

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}*:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
body{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);line-height:1.75}
a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--gold-soft)}
.main-banner{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000}
.banner-row{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:10px 16px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.banner-lrr{justify-self:start}.banner-logo{justify-self:center}
.banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:108px;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.banner-contact{justify-self:end;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;text-align:center}
.banner-phone{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px}
.banner-email{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;display:block}
.banner-tabs{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 12px 10px;display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.banner-tabs>a{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8);padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}
.banner-tabs>a:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);color:var(--gold)}
.banner-tabs>a.mil-link{color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin-left:6px}
header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));padding:60px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);text-align:center}
header>*{max-width:900px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,46px);color:#fff;line-height:1.15;margin:0 auto 14px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.lead,header p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;max-width:720px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 24px}
main p{color:var(--text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;margin:1rem auto;font-weight:400;max-width:760px}
main p strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
main h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,38px);line-height:1.18;color:#fff;margin:48px auto 16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold-line);letter-spacing:-0.01em;max-width:760px}
main h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,20px);color:var(--gold);margin:34px auto 12px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;max-width:760px}
main ul,main ol{color:var(--text);padding-left:1.25rem;margin:.75rem auto;font-weight:400;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.7;max-width:760px}
main li{margin:.4rem 0}
.cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.08),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.75rem;margin:2.5rem auto;text-align:center;max-width:760px}
.cta strong{color:#fff}
.cta a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
details{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:8px;margin:.5rem auto;padding:1rem 1.25rem;max-width:760px}
details[open]{border-color:var(--gold-line)}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17px}
details p{color:var(--text);margin-top:.75rem;font-size:16px}
footer{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 24px 3rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;text-align:center;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
footer p{margin:.5rem 0;color:var(--muted)}
footer a{color:var(--gold)}
.btn-p{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn-p:hover{background:var(--gold-soft);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-g{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:760px}
/* index hero */
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);padding:64px 24px}
.hero-grid{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.hero-eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}
.hero h1{text-align:left;margin:0 0 18px}
.hero .lead{text-align:left;margin:0 0 26px;max-width:560px}
.hero-portrait{border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow:hidden;line-height:0}
.hero-portrait img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top}
.trust-strip{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 26px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;background:var(--panel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);padding:16px 24px;text-align:center}
.trust-strip span{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.trust-strip strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.trust-strip .stars{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin:2rem auto;max-width:900px}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.card h3{margin:0!important;font-size:22px!important;text-transform:none!important;letter-spacing:0!important;color:#fff!important}
.card p{font-size:15px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0!important;flex:1}
.card a.card-link{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:900px}
.review-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.review-card .stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:10px}
.review-card p{color:#D1D5DB!important;font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.7!important;font-style:italic;margin:0 0 14px!important;flex:1}
.review-card .who{color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.review-card .meta{color:var(--mutedD);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:1rem auto 2rem;max-width:760px}
.chips a{background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;border:1px solid var(--hair)}
.chips a:hover{border-color:var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold)}
.mil-band{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:28px;margin:3rem auto;max-width:760px;text-align:center}
.mil-band h3{margin:0 0 10px!important}
.mil-band p{margin:0 0 16px!important}
.inq-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.10),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:14px;padding:26px 28px;margin:40px auto;max-width:760px}
.inq-cta .iq{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold-line);padding-left:14px}
.inq-cta .ih{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px;font-weight:500}
.inq-cta .is{color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 18px}
.inq-cta .ir{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.inq-cta .ip{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);letter-spacing:.3px;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.inq-cta .il{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line);color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;font-family:var(--sans)}
/* sticky mobile CTA */
.sticky-mobile-cta{display:none}
@media (max-width:800px){
  .sticky-mobile-cta{display:flex;gap:10px;position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:9999}
  .sticky-mobile-cta a{flex:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.2px;font-family:var(--sans);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-call{background:#C9A84C;color:#0A0F1A}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-text{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-email{background:#1A2332;color:#fff;border:1px solid #C9A84C}
  iframe[name="widgetCta"]{display:none!important}
}
/* inquiry modal */
.imodal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,15,26,0.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);z-index:2000;display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:80px 20px 40px;overflow-y:auto}
.imodal-overlay.open{display:flex}
.imodal{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:40px 32px 32px;width:100%;max-width:560px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6);text-align:left}
.imodal-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:14px;background:transparent;border:none;color:#999;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:6px}
.imodal h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;color:#fff;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center;font-weight:500;border:none;padding:0}
.imodal .isub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 8px;text-align:center}
.imodal form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-top:24px}
.imodal label{color:#999;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px}
.imodal input,.imodal select,.imodal textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--elev);border:1px solid #444;border-radius:8px;color:#fff;font-size:14px;outline:none;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ihp{position:absolute;left:-9999px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.imodal .isubmit{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);border:none;padding:14px 28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;margin-top:8px;font-family:var(--sans)}
.imodal .ifine{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:4px;text-align:center}
.imodal .iok{background:#1a3a1a;border:2px solid #3aa03a;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.imodal .ierr{background:#3a1a1a;border:1px solid #a03a3a;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#ff9999;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .hero-portrait{max-width:380px;margin:0 auto}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  main{padding:32px 16px}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:56px!important}
  .banner-row{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  main h2{font-size:25px!important;margin:38px auto 14px;padding-bottom:10px}
  main h3{font-size:17px!important}
  main h2,main h3{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
  main p{font-size:16.5px}
  main ul,main ol{font-size:16px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  main{padding:24px 14px 14px!important}
  header{padding:32px 14px 22px!important}
  .hero{padding:36px 14px!important}
  h1{font-size:clamp(22px,7vw,30px)!important}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:44px!important}
  .banner-phone{font-size:13px!important}
  .banner-email{font-size:9px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a{padding:4px 6px!important;font-size:9px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important}
}

/*FIGURE_CSS*/
.figure-band{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);line-height:0;margin:2.25rem auto .5rem;border:1px solid var(--hair);max-width:760px}
.figure-band picture{display:block}
.figure-band img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover}
.figure-band--tall img{aspect-ratio:auto;max-height:600px;object-fit:contain;background:var(--panel)}
.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
figure{margin:0}
figcaption{line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-style:italic;text-align:center;margin:8px 0 0;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.2px;padding:0 10px 10px}
figcaption a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline}
@media(max-width:640px){.figure-band--43 img{aspect-ratio:auto}}
.imodal .ifine a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:underline}

/* MOBILE_DRAWER_START */
/* The drawer markup stays in the page but is never shown; the toggle must be hidden at EVERY width. */
.nav-toggle{display:none!important}
.main-banner{position:sticky;top:0}
/* Phones: keep every top-level tab visible (owner preference). */
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .nav-toggle{display:none!important}
  .site-drawer{display:block!important;position:static!important;top:auto!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;background:none!important;padding:0!important;overflow:visible!important;z-index:auto!important}
  .main-banner{position:sticky!important;top:0!important;z-index:1000}
  /* even spacing around the logos and the phone rather than one item pinned to each edge */
  .banner-row{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;justify-content:space-evenly!important;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px 0!important;gap:8px!important;min-height:0!important}
  .banner-row>*{flex:0 0 auto}
  .banner-lrr{display:block!important;justify-self:start}
  .banner-logo{justify-self:center}
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:38px!important}
  .banner-tabs{display:flex!important;flex-direction:row!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:2px!important;padding:4px 6px 8px!important}
  .main-banner .banner-tabs>a,.main-banner .banner-tabs .dropdown>button,.main-banner .banner-tabs .banner-search{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:auto!important;min-height:30px;margin:0!important;padding:5px 8px!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:.3px!important;line-height:1.1;text-align:center!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;border-bottom:none!important;border-radius:6px!important}
  .banner-tabs>a.mil-link{border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin:0!important}
  .banner-tabs .dropdown{padding:0;position:relative}
  body.drawer-open{overflow:auto!important}
}
@media (max-width: 360px){
  /* the sticky bottom bar already carries Email; the header copy overflows below 360px */
  .main-banner .banner-email{display:none!important}
}
@media (max-width: 480px){
  .banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:32px!important}
  .banner-tabs{gap:1px!important;padding:3px 4px 7px!important}
  .main-banner .banner-tabs>a,.main-banner .banner-tabs .dropdown>button,.main-banner .banner-tabs .banner-search{padding:5px 6px!important;font-size:10.5px!important;letter-spacing:.2px!important}
}
/* MOBILE_DRAWER_END */
</style>

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}*:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
body{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);line-height:1.75}

.banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:108px;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.banner-contact{justify-self:end;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;text-align:center}
.banner-phone{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px}
.banner-email{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;display:block}
.banner-tabs{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 12px 10px;display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.banner-tabs>a{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8);padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}

main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 24px}

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}

  .sticky-mobile-cta .smc-call{background:#C9A84C;color:#0A0F1A}

.imodal-overlay.open{display:flex}

}

.quick-answer{max-width:760px;margin:6px auto 22px;padding:16px 20px;border:1px solid var(--gold-line,rgba(201,168,76,.35));border-left:4px solid var(--gold,#c9a84c);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel,rgba(255,255,255,.03))}.quick-answer .qa-label{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold,#c9a84c);font-weight:600}.quick-answer .qa-text{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--text,#e8e6df)}.quick-answer .qa-by{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#9aa0aa);font-style:italic}</style>

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}*:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
body{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);line-height:1.75}
a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{color:var(--gold-soft)}
.main-banner{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000}

.banner-lrr{justify-self:start}.banner-logo{justify-self:center}
.banner-lrr img,.banner-logo img{height:108px;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.banner-contact{justify-self:end;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;text-align:center}
.banner-phone{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px}
.banner-email{color:var(--gold)!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.3px;display:block}
.banner-tabs{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:6px 12px 10px;display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.banner-tabs>a{background:transparent;border:none;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8);padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--sans);text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px}
.banner-tabs>a:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);color:var(--gold)}
.banner-tabs>a.mil-link{color:var(--gold);border:1px solid var(--gold-line);margin-left:6px}
header{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--panel),var(--elev));padding:60px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);text-align:center}
header>*{max-width:900px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,46px);color:#fff;line-height:1.15;margin:0 auto 14px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.lead,header p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;max-width:720px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 24px}
main p{color:var(--text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.75;margin:1rem auto;font-weight:400;max-width:760px}
main p strong{color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
main h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,38px);line-height:1.18;color:#fff;margin:48px auto 16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold-line);letter-spacing:-0.01em;max-width:760px}
main h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,20px);color:var(--gold);margin:34px auto 12px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;max-width:760px}
main ul,main ol{color:var(--text);padding-left:1.25rem;margin:.75rem auto;font-weight:400;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.7;max-width:760px}

.cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,0.08),rgba(201,168,76,0.02));border:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:10px;padding:1.75rem;margin:2.5rem auto;text-align:center;max-width:760px}
.cta strong{color:#fff}
.cta a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
details{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:8px;margin:.5rem auto;padding:1rem 1.25rem;max-width:760px}

.hero-grid{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}

.tb-stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:21px;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(201,168,76,0.45)}
.tb-big{color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:32px;font-weight:600;line-height:1}

.tb-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.4px;line-height:1.4}

.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}

.card p{font-size:15px!important;color:var(--muted)!important;margin:0!important;flex:1}
.card a.card-link{font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.review-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:18px;margin:1.5rem auto;max-width:900px}
.review-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:14px;padding:26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}

}

</style>

<style>
:root{--ink:#0A0F1A;--panel:#121823;--elev:#1A2332;--hair:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--gold:#C9A84C;--gold-soft:#D4B768;--gold-line:rgba(201,168,76,0.35);--gold-tint:rgba(201,168,76,0.10);--text:#E8E6DF;--muted:#A5A496;--mutedD:#8f8e83;--serif:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter','DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}*:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold)!important;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:2px}
body{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:300;background:var(--ink);color:var(--text);line-height:1.75}

.main-banner{background:rgba(10,15,26,0.95);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000}
